_about: Spoken answers to tutor checks, labelled with the verdict a fair human teacher would give. Answers are written the way speech-to-text hands them over: paraphrases, mis-heard words (the FA for DFA, grassy ass for gracias), number words, partial answers, confident wrong answers, I-don't-know variants and MCQ picks. Used by tests/tutor_grade_eval.py (offline) and tests/tutor_grade_live.py (real free LLMs).
